description_en: Queries the details of a service instance by its region ID, service instance ID, or Alibaba Cloud Marketplace instance ID. The returned information includes the service status, template name, and a list of resources
description_zh: 通过地域ID、服务实例iD或者云市场实例ID、查询服务实例的详细信息，例如服务状态、模板名称、资源列表等信息
